title: Air Pollution After the Shutdown of U.S. Embassy Monitoring
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
For more than a decade, US embassies and consulates provided independent, publicly accessible air-quality information in cities worldwide. In 2025, this program was abruptly suspended, generating sharp drops in the availability of trusted pollution information. We evaluate the consequences of this change using real-time satellite-derived aerosol optical depth (AOD) and a matched difference-in-differences design with same-country control cities. Across 46 cities, we find no systematic trends prior to the halt in US reporting, and a prompt 24 to 33% increase in local pollution levels after reporting stopped. Calibrating AOD to concurrent preshutdown embassy PM
2.5
readings, the main estimate corresponds to an approximate PM
2.5
-equivalent increase of 1.9
μ
g/m
3
under our preferred conservative translation, with alternative approaches yielding values between 1.5 and 16.3
μ
g/m
3
. Estimated effects are largest and most persistent in cities with poor substitutes for the US-provided data. The findings indicate that pollution reductions are not guaranteed by either previous air quality improvements or the legacy of reliable environmental data.
abstract_zh: 十多年来，美国大使馆和领事馆在全球各城市提供独立、公开可获取的空气质量信息。2025年，该项目突然暂停，导致可信污染信息的可获得性急剧下降。我们利用实时卫星反演的气溶胶光学厚度（AOD），并采用以同国对照城市为对照的匹配双重差分设计，评估了这一变化的后果。在46个城市中，我们在美国停止报告之前未发现系统性趋势，而在报告停止后，当地污染水平随即上升了24%至33%。将AOD与停止前同期的大使馆PM2.5读数进行校准后，在我们偏好的保守换算下，主要估计值对应于约1.9 μg/m³的PM2.5等效增幅；其他方法得到的数值介于1.5至16.3 μg/m³之间。效应在缺乏美国所提供数据替代来源的城市中最大，也最为持久。研究结果表明，污染减少既无法依靠此前的空气质量改善得到保证，也无法依靠可靠环境数据的遗留得到保证。

title: Biodiversity Co-benefits in Carbon Markets? Evidence from Voluntary Offset Projects
abstract: The ongoing Holocene Extinction marks the fastest rate of species loss in human history. In the absence of effective public policies, nature-based solutions implemented through market mechanisms-most notably carbon offsets-have emerged as a rapidly growing asset class that often promote biodiversity co-benefits for investors. This study provides the first systematic evidence on how voluntary carbon offsets impact habitat quality. We compile the largest extant dataset of voluntary carbon offset projects and link them to high-resolution satellite-derived measures of habitat integrity in local ecosystems. Contrary to asserted co-benefits, we find carbon offset projects are associated with a 3.7% increase in habitat disturbance, as measured by the Human Influence Index (HII). Land-use analyses show that these projects tend to accelerate the conversion of biodiverse shrublands and less-dense forests into pastures and simplified landscapes, implying reduced habitat integrity and ecological trade-offs. We examine impact heterogeneity by ecosystem condition, certifications, stated co-benefits, protected area overlap, registry, and rating coverage, but still find no evidence of improved habitats. Nor do alternative habitat measures, the Bioclimate Ecosystem Resilience Index and the Biodiversity Habitat Index, show measurable improvement following offset projects. We conclude that voluntary carbon markets have ecological performance gaps and information frictions relevant to both investors and offset market governance.
abstract_zh: 当前的全新世大灭绝标志着人类历史上物种丧失速度最快的时期。在缺乏有效公共政策的情况下，通过市场机制实施的基于自然的解决方案，尤其是碳抵消，已成为一类快速增长的资产类别，并常被宣传能为投资者带来生物多样性协同效益。本研究首次系统地提供了自愿碳抵消如何影响栖息地质量的证据。我们汇编了现存规模最大的自愿碳抵消项目数据集，并将其与基于高分辨率卫星测量的当地生态系统栖息地完整性指标相连接。与所宣称的协同效益相反，我们发现，碳抵消项目与栖息地干扰增加3.7%相关，该干扰以人类影响指数（Human Influence Index，HII）衡量。土地利用分析表明，这些项目倾向于加速将生物多样性较高的灌木地和较稀疏的森林转变为牧场和简化的景观，这意味着栖息地完整性下降以及生态权衡。我们按生态系统状况、认证、宣称的协同效益、与保护区的重叠程度、注册机构和评级覆盖范围检验了影响的异质性，但仍未发现栖息地改善的证据。替代性的栖息地指标，即生物气候生态系统韧性指数（Bioclimate Ecosystem Resilience Index）和生物多样性栖息地指数（Biodiversity Habitat Index），在抵消项目实施后也未显示出可测量的改善。我们的结论是，自愿碳市场存在生态绩效缺口和信息摩擦，这对投资者和抵消市场治理均具有重要意义。

title: Wind Turbine Proximity and Health: Longitudinal Evidence from U.S. Households
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Rapid growth of wind energy plays a key role in global efforts to reduce carbon emissions, yet public concerns persist about its potential health effects, particularly through noise exposure. While some studies and media reports suggest that wind turbines may contribute to sleep disturbances, anxiety, and even suicide, existing evidence remains limited and inconclusive. This study combines geolocated data on turbines from the U.S. Wind Turbine Database with longitudinal survey data on over 120,000 households (2011–2023) and consumer purchasing records to assess whether proximity to wind turbines affects mental and physical health. We examine a wide range of outcomes, including depression, anxiety, sleep disorders, headaches, and use of sleep aids and painkillers. Comparing households before and after nearby turbine installations, we find no detectable adverse health effects from turbine exposure at typical exposure distances. While we cannot rule out small effects, our confidence intervals exclude moderate-to-large impacts, suggesting that fears about substantial health impacts are not borne out in population-level data. Other disamenities such as noise, shadow flicker, and visual intrusion may still affect quality of life even absent measurable health impacts. Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.
abstract_zh: 风能的快速增长在全球减少碳排放的努力中发挥着关键作用，但公众仍担心其可能对健康产生影响，尤其是通过噪声暴露。尽管一些研究和媒体报道认为，风力涡轮机可能导致睡眠障碍、焦虑，甚至自杀，但现有证据仍然有限且尚无定论。本研究将美国风力涡轮机数据库中带有地理位置的涡轮机数据，与超过12万户家庭（2011–2023年）的纵向调查数据及消费者购买记录相结合，以评估风力涡轮机的邻近程度是否影响心理和身体健康。我们考察了广泛的结果，包括抑郁、焦虑、睡眠障碍、头痛，以及安眠药和止痛药的使用。通过比较附近风机安装前后的家庭，我们发现，在典型暴露距离下，涡轮机暴露并未产生可检测到的不利健康效应。虽然我们无法排除小效应的存在，但我们的置信区间排除了中等至较大的影响，这表明在人口层面的数据中，关于重大健康影响的担忧并未得到证实。噪声、阴影闪烁和视觉侵扰等其他不良影响，即使在没有可测量健康影响的情况下，仍可能影响生活质量。NBER工作论文系列的机构订阅者，以及发展中国家的居民，可在www.nber.org免费下载本文。

title: Environmental Impacts of China's Overseas Development Projects
Rapid Increases in Methane Concentrations Following August 2020 Suspension of the US Methane Rule
venue: Environmental and Energy Policy and the Economy
abstract: In August 2020, the Trump administration removed Obama-era federal requirements that oil and gas firms detect and repair methane leaks. We merge geographic information system coordinates of 1,193,575 wells, 478 natural gas processing facilities, and 1,367 compressor stations to geo-identified methane concentrations from the European TROPOspheric Monitoring Instrument (TROPOMI, satellite instrument). Using a difference-in-differences design, we find a large, prompt increase in US methane emissions at oil and gas infrastructure sites following the August 2020 rollback relative to areas without such infrastructure. Average methane concentrations increased by 5 parts per billion (ppb), or one-quarter of a standard deviation. The number of high methane emission events from the oil and gas sector more than doubled relative to the coal sector, which did not experience the rollback. Gas producers and distributors have argued they face an overriding incentive to minimize fugitive methane emissions and venting without regulation—so as to recover and sell a valuable commercial product. The large and nimble response to federal policy we find—together with basic microeconomic theory—indicates otherwise and provides empirical support for policy’s central role in curbing global methane concentrations.
abstract_zh: 2020年8月，特朗普政府取消了奥巴马时期对油气企业的联邦要求，即这些企业须检测并修复甲烷泄漏。我们将1,193,575口油井、478座天然气处理设施和1,367座压缩机站的地理信息系统坐标，与欧洲对流层监测仪（TROPOMI，卫星仪器）提供的地理定位甲烷浓度数据相匹配。利用双重差分设计，我们发现，相较于不存在此类基础设施的地区，在2020年8月放松管制之后，油气基础设施所在地的美国甲烷排放立即出现大幅增长。平均甲烷浓度上升了5个十亿分率（ppb），相当于四分之一个标准差。油气行业的高甲烷排放事件数量相对于未经历放松管制的煤炭行业增加了一倍多。天然气生产商和分销商曾主张，他们面临压倒性的动机，即在没有监管的情况下尽量减少逸散性甲烷排放和放空，以回收并出售这种有价值的商品。我们发现的对联邦政策的大幅而迅速的反应，加之基本的微观经济理论，表明情况并非如此，并为政策在遏制全球甲烷浓度方面的核心作用提供了实证支持。

title: Bitcoin and carbon dioxide emissions: Evidence from daily production decisions
abstract: Environmental externalities from cryptomining may be large, but have not been linked causally to mining incentives. We exploit daily variation in Bitcoin price as a natural experiment for an 86 megawatt coal-fired power plant with on-site cryptomining. We find that carbon emissions respond swiftly to mining incentives, with price elasticities of 0.69-0.71 in the short-run and 0.33-0.40 in the longer run.A $1 increase in Bitcoin price leads to $3.11-$6.79 in external damages from carbon emissions alone, well exceeding cryptomining's value added (using a $190 social cost of carbon, but ignoring increased local air pollution).As cryptomining requires ever more computing power to mine a given number of blocks, our study highlights both the revitalization of US fossil assets and the potential value of financial industry accounting standards that incorporate cryptomining externalities.
abstract_zh: 加密货币挖矿产生的环境外部性可能很大，但此前尚未与挖矿激励建立起因果联系。我们利用比特币价格的日度变化作为自然实验，研究一座装机容量为86兆瓦、配备现场加密货币挖矿设备的燃煤电厂。我们发现，碳排放对挖矿激励反应迅速，短期价格弹性为0.69–0.71，长期价格弹性为0.33–0.40。比特币价格每上涨1美元，仅碳排放一项就会带来3.11–6.79美元的外部损害（采用190美元的碳的社会成本，但不考虑当地空气污染加剧的影响），这远超加密货币挖矿的增加值。随着挖出一定数量区块所需的计算能力越来越强，我们的研究既凸显了美国化石能源资产的复兴，也凸显了将加密货币挖矿外部性纳入金融行业会计准则的潜在价值。

Carbon Trading Pilot Programs in China and Local Air Quality
abstract: China emits twice as much CO_2 as the United States. Launched in seven regions in 2013-2014, China's pilot carbon-trading programs cover roughly 7 percent of China's CO_2 emissions. These market-based policies offer the best existing evidence as to whether the national carbon-trading program starting in 2021 will curb emissions. Here, we analyze changes in air quality using visibility measures from weather stations. We find the pilot programs improved local air quality, and this was likely a co-benefit of reduced carbon emissions. However, these improvements were modest, and there is some evidence of pollution leakage to the nonpilot regions.
abstract_zh: 中国的二氧化碳（CO2）排放量是美国的两倍。中国的碳交易试点项目于2013至2014年在七个地区启动，覆盖了中国约7%的二氧化碳排放。这些以市场为基础的政策，为2021年启动的全国碳交易计划能否遏制排放提供了现有的最佳证据。在此，我们利用气象站的能见度数据分析空气质量的变化。我们发现，试点项目改善了当地空气质量，这很可能是减少碳排放所带来的协同效益。然而，这些改善幅度有限，并且有一些证据表明存在污染向非试点地区转移的现象。

title: Fetal Origins and Parental Responses

From Infant to Mother: Early Disease Environment and Future Maternal Health
abstract: This paper examines the links between the disease environment around the time of a woman's birth, and her health at the time she delivers her own infant. Our results suggest that exposure to disease in early childhood significantly increases the incidence of diabetes in the population of future mothers. The exposed mothers are less likely to be married, have fewer years of education, are more likely to gain over 60 pounds while pregnant, and are more likely to smoke while pregnant. Not surprisingly then, exposure increases the probability of low birth weight in the next generation, at least among whites. Among whites, this effect remains when we control for maternal behaviors as well as disease exposure. Among blacks, we find that maternal exposure reduces the incidence of low birth weight. The difference between whites and blacks may reflect a "scarring" vs. selection story; whites who go on to have children are negatively impacted, while blacks who go on to have children are positively selected having survived a higher early childhood mortality rate.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了女性出生时所处的疾病环境与其分娩自己婴儿时的健康状况之间的联系。我们的结果表明，幼年期接触疾病会显著提高未来母亲群体的糖尿病发病率。接触过疾病的母亲更不可能已婚，受教育年限更少，怀孕期间体重增加超过60磅的可能性更大，怀孕期间吸烟的可能性也更大。因此，接触疾病也会提高下一代低出生体重的概率，至少在白人中如此。在白人中，即使控制了母亲行为和疾病暴露，这一效应依然存在。在黑人中，我们发现母亲的疾病暴露反而降低了低出生体重的发生率。白人与黑人之间的差异，可能反映了“创伤”（scarring）与“选择”（selection）两种不同的解释：生育子女的白人女性受到了负面影响，而生育子女的黑人女性则因在幼年期存活下来、经历了较高的早期儿童死亡率，而呈现正向选择。

title: After Midnight: A Regression Discontinuity Design in Length of Postpartum Hospital Stays
Health Capital and the Prenatal Environment: The Effect of Ramadan Observance During Pregnancy
abstract: This paper uses the Islamic holy month of Ramadan as a natural experiment in diurnal fasting and fetal health. Among births to Arab parents in Michigan, we find prenatal exposure to Ramadan results in lower birth weight. Exposure in the first month of gestation also reduces the number of male births. Turning to long-term “fetal origins” effects, we find Muslims in Uganda and Iraq are 20 percent more likely to be disabled as adults if early pregnancy overlapped with Ramadan. Estimated effects are larger for mental (or learning) disabilities. Our results suggest that relatively mild prenatal exposures can have persistent effects. (JEL I12, J16, O15, O17, Z12)
abstract_zh: 本文以伊斯兰教斋月（Ramadan）作为昼间禁食与胎儿健康的自然实验。在密歇根州阿拉伯裔父母所生的婴儿中，我们发现孕期暴露于斋月会导致出生体重降低。妊娠第一个月的暴露还会减少男婴的出生数量。在长期的“胎儿起源”效应方面，我们发现，若怀孕早期与斋月重叠，乌干达和伊拉克的穆斯林成年后残疾的可能性高出20%。对精神（或学习）残疾的估计效应更大。我们的结果表明，相对温和的产前暴露也可能产生持久影响。（JEL I12, J16, O15, O17, Z12）

Too little too late? Nationwide carbon trading in China
abstract: China, the world’s largest carbon emitter, launched a national carbon emissions trading system (ETS) in 2021. Using new plant-level data from satellite imagery and machine learning, we find that high-efficiency power plants increased electricity generation and CO2 emissions by approximately 5%, while low-efficiency plants showed no output response –consistent with theoretical predictions for rate-based trading. Neither plant type reduced emission intensity. Power-sector CO2 also increased relative to other Asian coal fleets with no carbon market. Increased emissions from high-efficiency plants further worsened downwind air quality. These findings reflect the current system’s generous benchmarks, which depress carbon prices and weaken the incentive for inefficient plants to reduce emission intensity. Tightening benchmarks is the necessary next step for carbon trading to reduce emissions in China and the developing countries adopting similar systems.
abstract_zh: 中国作为全球最大的碳排放国，于2021年启动了全国碳排放权交易体系（ETS）。利用卫星影像与机器学习得到的新工厂级数据，我们发现高效率电厂的发电量和二氧化碳排放量增加了约5%，而低效率电厂的产出则没有反应，这与基于排放强度交易（rate-based trading）的理论预测一致。两类电厂的排放强度均未下降。与没有碳市场的其他亚洲燃煤机组相比，电力部门的二氧化碳排放也有所增加。高效率电厂排放的增加进一步恶化了下风向地区的空气质量。这些发现反映出，现行体系设定的基准值较为宽松，压低了碳价，削弱了低效率电厂降低排放强度的激励。收紧基准值是碳交易在中国以及采用类似体系的发展中国家真正减少排放的必要下一步。
